deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Wix site's editor and navigate to the 'Marketplace' app.
Click on 'Settings' and then 'Integrations', then search for the 'Returns Reason Capture' app.
Click on the app and follow the installation instructions to add it to your site.
Once installed, navigate to the 'Returns Reason Capture' app settings and select the 'Form' tab.
Click on the 'Embed Form' button and copy the provided code snippet.
Go to your Wix site's editor and navigate to the page where you want to embed the returns reason capture form.
Click on the '+' icon to add a new element, then search for 'HTML Code' and drag it onto the page.
Paste the copied code snippet into the HTML Code element and click 'Apply' to save the changes.
The returns reason capture form should now be embedded on your Wix site, capturing the reason for returns from customers.
